notes: Black Knight 2000 power-up probe: trough switches 11, 12, 13 held at 1 (full trough) from emulator start; observe the ROM's own power-up sequence for 20 s. The Auto-Up/Manual-Down switch (-6) is held at Auto-Up (1), the normal play position, from emulator start. No other host input; the harness never moves a ball or a mechanism.
